def transform(grid):
    # The 1-shape is a marker template. Replace its cells with the other colored motif.
    # Find connected components of nonzero cells by color; in each motif the 1s become 8s.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==1: out[r][c]=8
    return out
PY
